thread:
OpsBot: Alert triggered: spike in 5xxs and per-token latency in eu-west-1 pools. Auto-ticket created.
Samir Patel: Customers in EU reporting slow responses and occasional 500s. Initial triage shows KV cache hit-rate collapse.
Priya Shah: Confirmed eviction storm on mcache-eu-* around 16:45 UTC. eviction_rate ~8x, cache_hit_rate dropped to ~60% from ~98%.
Jenna Liu: Kicking immediate mitigations: disable prefetch and cap prefix concurrency to 8 on eu-west runtime. Live config patch queued: `runtime.config.prefetch=false; routing.max_prefix_concurrency=8`
Marco Rivera: Canary apply on pod eu-r-73 now. Watching errors + latency for 2m.
CS Team: Notifying affected accounts with PS heads-up.
OpsBot: Canary completed on eu-r-73, no crashes.
Jenna Liu: Canary metrics: hit-rate improving to ~85%, 5xxs down ~60%. Also temporarily lowered batching for top models.
Priya Shah: Enabled automatic fallback to quantized companion models for strict-SLO customers; fallback rate ~12%.
Marco Rivera: Deploying hotfix to throttle eviction under write bursts (rev a1b2c3d). Rolling to all eu-west nodes.
Samir Patel: Drafting public status update; holding until rollout verification.
StatusBot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1791239999 (notes redacted).
Jenna Liu: Monitoring: 10/12 pools back to baseline error rates; token latency trending down.
Priya Shah: Next steps: complete hotfix rollout, assign postmortem, coordinate CS follow-ups.
Marco Rivera: Hotfix rollout finished at 17:23 UTC. No further eviction spikes observed.
Samir Patel: Incident classified customer-visible; severity S3 -> S2. Keeping channel open for 60m then prepping postmortem.
Jenna Liu: Postmortem owner assigned. ETA initial draft: EOD tomorrow.
OpsBot: Alerts suppressed at 17:30 UTC; will reopen if thresholds breach.
Samir Patel: Final internal status: mitigated, ongoing monitoring. Internal runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction
StatusBot: Prepared public message: "We experienced degraded inference performance in eu-west-1 due to a cache eviction storm. Mitigations applied and service restored for most customers. Full postmortem to follow." Pending Samir approval. :white_check_mark:
